profile.name: Shathurjan Muhunthan
profile.role: Aerospace engineering student at Toronto Metropolitan University.
profile.intro:
I work across mechanical design, aerospace systems, and hands-on prototyping — connecting analysis with things that move, fly, and function.

I’m pursuing a BEng in Aerospace Engineering at Toronto Metropolitan University. My experience spans parametric CAD, student rocketry, UAV structures, and embedded systems. Alongside engineering, I’m training toward a Glider Pilot Licence — bringing a practical perspective on aircraft handling and flight safety to the way I approach design.

Aerospace Engineering student experienced in CAD, propulsion systems, robotics, and flight training. Skilled in concept-to-test workflows involving simulation, design, prototyping, manufacturing, and verification. Recognised for data-driven problem solving, precision modelling, and cross-disciplinary collaboration across aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, and controls.
profile.contactIntro: I’m looking for internship and co-op opportunities where I can contribute to design, analysis, and testing while learning from experienced engineers.
